title: Fresh contradictory QA after M3.3 sourceId portability repairs

findings.title: M3.3 consume-review retains loose sourceId prefix matching after exact verification repair
findings.cause: verify-review resolves source artifacts by exact deterministic sourceId plus known suffix, but consume_review_bundle still selects members with startswith('sources/<sourceId>.'), so a valid base ID and extension-like child ID become ambiguous during FactoryRun materialization.
reproduction: Create two valid transient admissions for sourceIds Course and Course.pdf using PDF bytes.
verify-review succeeds and binds distinct exact members sources/Course.pdf and sources/Course.pdf.pdf.
consume-review for sourceId Course sees both members through loose prefix matching and raises HandoffInputError: source artifact path for Course is not unique.
The same failure is reproduced with extension-like child IDs Course.zip, Course.txt and Course.bin using suffix-interaction payloads.
Reproduced independently on ubuntu-latest and a real windows-latest runner.
findings.impact: Transient identities accepted by admission and accepted by M3.3 prepare/verify can still fail the mandatory M3.3 consume boundary, so the repaired product does not provide end-to-end portable review handoff for the admitted identity set.
